body: From the DM-172 review (orchestrator, this run) — MUST FIX in this ticket before reading timing segments: fractional milliseconds produce malformed timestamps. `src/core/space/timingIntervals.ts:35-47` (`intervalOf`/`iso`) does not truncate and `timingActivity.ts:65` computes `end - value`; `active_ms` 600000.5 with no spanStart gives `2026-11-01T10:19:59.999.5Z` (Date.parse NaN). Add `Math.trunc` and show it in your scratch script. Also note: sprint totals under the `current_plan` rule are not confined to the sprint window (never divide sprint effort/in-flight by its `elapsed`), and 'host wins' dedupe matches by identity not overlap, so host 10:00-10:10 + agent 10:20-11:00 leaves 50m unknown (timingActivity.ts:146-159) — treat as unknown, never as zero overhead.
